text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I see... So you're practicing all by 
yourself..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...I know you're a hard worker, and I'm 
sure you genuinely want to be helpful to 
everyone."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"But... aren't you pushing yourself a bit 
too hard?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "Ayabe-san..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Uuu... Thank you so much for worrying 
about me. But, but doing this much isn't 
nearly enough..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I've received so much help from so many 
people this year too..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Fukukitaru-san always listens to my 
worries, does fortune-tellings for me, and 
searches for good-luck charms with me."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Urara-san always greets me with a smile, 
and encourages someone like me by saying 
'Good job!' and 'You're trying so hard!'"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Opera O-san is always shining so 
brightly... She's my inspiration. Because 
of her, I can always look forward..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "And then there's you, Ayabe-san..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"You always give me courage, Ayabe-san. 
...For instance, do you remember?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Uuu... I messed up again... Slipping on 
the uphill slope... crashing right into 
the rail..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I'm... always so clumsy... and slow... 
Can someone like me really ever become 
like Opera O-san...?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"(Should I just... give up...? But, still, 
maybe just a little more practice...)"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"(Huh...? Is someone still out here at 
this hour...?)"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Haa... haa. ...Kh, ugh.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Ayabe-san was practicing too... 
Though she looks a little tired...?)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, A-Ayabe-san...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Doto? 
...What is it? Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? N-N-No, nothing's wrong with 
me...! 
More importantly, are you okay? You're not 
pushing yourself, are you...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm not pushing myself. 
Until I reach that "star," I can't afford 
to stop running...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: That... "star"...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Do you think... you'll reach it? Even 
though it's so, so far away...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm practicing until this late so I can 
reach it. Isn't it the same for you?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Back then... that gave me the courage 
to keep running, so that I could reach my 
own "star" someday too...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You and everyone else... are my 
benefactors. 
You've always been so kind and warm to 
me...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm always so clumsy and useless, 
and I have so much to reflect on and get 
down about, but—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Being with all of you makes me feel so 
happy...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
S-So, I felt that next year, I want to... 
no, I MUST repay all the happiness 
everyone gave me...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Doto...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
This is why I can't just leave you alone, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... so, I'm going to go practice a 
little more after all. 
Knowing you cared enough to worry about 
me... gave me my energy back...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Well then... th-thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(At this rate, she's definitely going 
to...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief. ...There's no helping it, 
is there?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Later that night—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hawaa~... I'm so tired... I don't feel 
like I've gotten 
any better despite all that practice, 
though—wait, h-huh...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: What's this on my desk...? Books?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-Whaa?! Are these karuta books... so many 
of them...?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Tips on memorizing poems... and practice 
methods for both Callers and Catchers... 
th-this is amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Who on earth... could have left these 
here—? 
Ah, there's a note tucked inside...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Efficiency is also important in 
practice—"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Did Ayabe-san leave this...? 
To think she'd do all this for me...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Ayabe-san...! 
I'll study hard and totally become great 
at karoota! ...I bit my tongue!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-All right! T-Tonight, I'm staying up all 
night reading...!
